heading: Let’s collaborate.
text:
Professional, research-based guidance on navigating your child’s communication, whether they are a current or potential AAC user, a gestalt language processor, have other communication needs or mobility limitations, or you are just unsure where to begin.

Through empathy and open-mindedness, we’re here to help you find clear, individualized and effective directives for your child’s communication.
photo_description: An adult's hand gently holding a child's hand

steps.title: Introduction
steps.text: A virtual introduction meeting to talk through your family’s experiences and coaching needs.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: Clear and direct advice, collaboration and troubleshooting, resource sharing, and coaching and training individualized to fit your family’s needs.

steps.title: Follow-up
steps.text: A virtual follow-up meeting to tie up the loose ends.

note: First-time participants select the 3-step coaching sequence. 45-minute follow-up consultations are available afterward. **Parent & caregiver coaching is available virtually from any state.**
